info.title: Databricks Agentkit API (workspace)
info.description: OpenAPI specification for the Databricks agentkit service (workspace-level APIs), generated from the Databricks Python SDK.

deployment_name.description: The Databricks workspace deployment name: the host prefix of the workspace URL (dbc-abcd0123-a1bc on AWS, adb-1234567890123456.7 on Azure, 1234567890123456 on GCP). Set DATABRICKS_DEPLOYMENT_NAME to default it for the session.

workspace_domain.description: The Databricks workspace domain suffix for the cloud. Selected by DATABRICKS_CLOUD (aws, azure or gcp; default aws).

post.description:

post.summary: Creates a memory entry using exclusive-create semantics. Callers may choose the entry ID; the service
post.description:
Creates a memory entry using exclusive-create semantics. Callers may choose the entry ID; the service
generates one when it is omitted. Returns ``ALREADY_EXISTS`` when an entry with the same actor,
session, and path already exists. Omitted ``session_id`` is its own uniqueness key: two
omitted-session entries with the same actor and path conflict, but an omitted-session entry does not
conflict with a session-scoped entry at the same actor and path.

:param parent: str
  Memory store that will contain the entry, in the form ``memory-stores/{managed_memory_store_id}``.
:param managed_memory_entry: :class:`ManagedMemoryEntry`
  The memory entry to create.
:param managed_memory_entry_id: str (optional)
  Optional caller-selected memory entry ID. The service generates an ID when omitted.

:returns: :class:`ManagedMemoryEntry`

parameters.name: managed_memory_store_id
parameters.description: The `managed_memory_store_id` segment of the `parent` resource name (`memory-stores/{managed_memory_store_id}`). Memory store that will contain the entry, in the form ``memory-stores/{managed_memory_store_id}``.

parameters.name: managed_memory_entry_id
parameters.description: Optional caller-selected memory entry ID. The service generates an ID when omitted.

actor_id.description: Customer-provided identifier for the actor whose memory this entry represents.

path.description: Absolute, case-sensitive path identifying the entry within its actor and optional session. Paths must begin with ``/`` and must not contain empty, ``.`` or ``..`` segments.

create_time.description: Time when the entry was created.

description.description: Human-readable description of the memory entry.

name.description: Resource name in the form ``memory-stores/{managed_memory_store_id}/entries/{managed_memory_entry_id}``. Required for updates; assigned by the service on creation.

session_id.description: Optional identifier for the session associated with this memory entry. When omitted, the entry applies across the actor's sessions.

source_type.description: Which writer created this entry. Caller sets this on Create; immutable after creation.

update_time.description: Time when the entry was last updated.

get.summary: Lists memory entries for one actor. An exact ``path`` filters entries across sessions, ignoring
get.description:
Lists memory entries for one actor. An exact ``path`` filters entries across sessions, ignoring
session metadata. Otherwise, ``session_id`` and ``path_prefix`` restrict the actor partition. ``view``
controls whether each returned entry includes memory content.

:param parent: str
  Memory store whose entries are listed, in the form ``memory-stores/{managed_memory_store_id}``.
:param actor_id: str
  Customer-provided identifier for the actor whose entries are listed.
:param page_size: int (optional)
  Maximum number of entries to return. The service may return fewer entries than requested. Defaults
  to 10; must be between 1 and 100.
:param page_token: str (optional)
  Opaque pagination token from a previous ListManagedMemoryEntries response.
:param path_prefix: str (optional)
  Optional path prefix used to restrict entries within the actor partition.
:param session_id: str (optional)
  Optional session identifier. When set, only entries with this exact ``session_id`` are returned.
  Omitted-session (cross-session) entries are not included. Ignored when path is set.
:param view: :class:`ManagedMemoryEntryView` (optional)
  Controls whether each returned entry includes memory content. Defaults to ``FULL``.

:returns: Iterator over :class:`ManagedMemoryEntry`

post.summary: Creates a memory store in the caller's workspace.
post.description:
Creates a memory store in the caller's workspace.

:param managed_memory_store: :class:`ManagedMemoryStore`
  The memory store to create.
:param managed_memory_store_id: str
  Caller-provided, workspace-unique memory store ID. It must be 3-56 characters, begin with a
  lowercase letter, contain only lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens, and end with a letter or
  digit.

:returns: :class:`ManagedMemoryStore`

parameters.name: managed_memory_store_id
parameters.description: Caller-provided, workspace-unique memory store ID. It must be 3-56 characters, begin with a lowercase letter, contain only lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens, and end with a letter or digit.

create_time.description: Time when the store was created.

creator_user_id.description: Workspace-local user ID of the authenticated principal that created the store. This is immutable server-set attribution and does not grant access; authorization is evaluated from the authenticated request context.

description.description: Human-readable description of the memory store.

display_name.description: Deprecated compatibility alias for the caller-provided memory store ID. Canonical clients provide the ID through ``CreateMemoryStoreRequest.managed_memory_store_id`` and use ``name`` as the resource identifier.

owner_user_id.description: Deprecated alias for ``creator_user_id``. This identifies the original creator, not a transferable owner. Use ``creator_user_id`` instead.

backend_id.description: Backend-specific identifier. For Lakebase, this is the project ID.

storage_backend.description: Service-managed storage backing this memory store.

update_time.description: Time when the store was last updated.

workspace_id.description: Workspace that owns the memory store.

post.summary: Creates a session within a session store.
post.description:
Creates a session within a session store.

:param parent: str
  Resource name of the containing session store, in the form ``session-stores/{session_store_id}``.
:param session: :class:`Session`
  The session to create. ``actor_id`` is required. A session with ``parent_session_id`` is a child and
  must use its parent's ``actor_id``. Independent forks are created only through ``ForkSession``.
:param session_id: str (optional)
  Optional caller-selected session ID. The service generates a UUID when this field is omitted. The ID
  must be unique; a collision returns ``ALREADY_EXISTS``.

:returns: :class:`Session`

parameters.name: session_store_id
parameters.description: The `session_store_id` segment of the `parent` resource name (`session-stores/{session_store_id}`). Resource name of the containing session store, in the form ``session-stores/{session_store_id}``.

parameters.name: session_id
parameters.description: Optional caller-selected session ID. The service generates a UUID when this field is omitted. The ID must be unique; a collision returns ``ALREADY_EXISTS``.

actor_id.description: Opaque caller-provided identifier for the application actor associated with the session. This is application data and has no Databricks authentication or authorization semantics. Use the same value as the Managed Memory Entry ``actor_id`` when storing memories associated with this actor. Every session must set it. A child session must use the same value as its parent.

create_time.description: Time when the session was created.

last_activity_time.description: Time when the session's item history was last mutated.

parent_session_id.description: Immediate parent session ID. Set only at creation for child sessions, immutable thereafter, and restricted to the same store.

root_session_id.description: Top-level session ID in the spawn tree. This equals ``session_id`` for a root or fork and is inherited transitively by child sessions.

session_id.description: Unique session ID. The service generates a UUID unless the caller supplies ``CreateSessionRequest.session_id``.

update_time.description: Time when session resource fields last changed.

get.summary: Lists sessions within a session store.
get.description:
Lists sessions within a session store.

:param parent: str
  Resource name of the containing session store, in the form ``session-stores/{session_store_id}``.
:param filter: str (optional)
  Filter expression. Supported fields include ``actor_id`` and ``metadata``; for example, ``actor_id =
  "support-customer-123"``.
:param order_by: str (optional)
  Sort order. Defaults to ``last_activity_time desc``. Page-token continuation is exactly-once when
  ordering by ``create_time`` (immutable); ordering by ``last_activity_time`` is best-effort, because
  that value changes as a session gains activity, so a session updated between page requests may be
  repeated or skipped. To enumerate every session exactly once, order by ``create_time``.
:param page_size: int (optional)
  Maximum number of sessions to return. Defaults to 10; must be between 1 and 100.
:param page_token: str (optional)
  Token returned by a previous list request.

:returns: Iterator over :class:`Session`

post.summary: Searches memory entries by text query for one actor. Returns matching entries and scores ranked by
post.description:
Searches memory entries by text query for one actor. Returns matching entries and scores ranked by
relevance; ``view`` controls whether each returned entry includes content.

:param parent: str
  Memory store whose entries are searched, in the form ``memory-stores/{managed_memory_store_id}``.
:param actor_id: str
  Customer-provided identifier for the actor whose entries are searched.
:param query: str
  Free-form search query.
:param limit: int (optional)
  Deprecated alias for ``page_size``. When both fields are set, their values must match.
:param page_size: int (optional)
  Maximum number of relevance-ranked entries to return. Defaults to 10 and must be between 1 and 100.
:param page_token: str (optional)
  Reserved for pagination compatibility. The server currently ignores this field because Search
  returns a ranked top-N result set.
:param path_prefix: str (optional)
  Optional absolute, case-sensitive path prefix used to restrict searched entries within the actor
  partition. The prefix must begin with ``/`` and must not contain empty, ``.`` or ``..`` segments.
:param session_id: str (optional)
  Optional session identifier. When set, only entries with this exact ``session_id`` are searched.
  Omitted-session (cross-session) entries are not included.
:param view: :class:`ManagedMemoryEntryView` (optional)
  Controls whether each returned entry includes memory content. Search scores are always returned.
  Defaults to ``FULL``.

:returns: Iterator over :class:`ManagedMemoryEntrySearchResult`
